title: Rav Huna bar Toreta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 127a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.127a.16-17), saying: “Once I went to Va’ad and saw a snake wrapped around a lizard… When I came before Rabbi Shimon the Pious,” etc. Yuchasin cites from a Midrash that he was a convert, and that because his cow would not plow on Shabbat he became a Jew; the story is cited in [Pesikta Rabbati, piska Parah](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesikta_Rabbati.14.1), and the reading Hyman uses is Rabbi Yochanan ben Toreta.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Chullin names Rav Huna bar Toreta in the snake and tzav account. The Pesikta names Rabbi Yochanan ben Tortah in the story of the cow. [Heilprin’s Huna entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=974&lang=en) gives both stories. The two primary passages name different figures.
